command_receipts_result_check.name: command_receipts_result_check
command_receipts_result_check.value: ("command_receipts"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "command_receipts"."response_body" IS NULL AND "command_receipts"."response_status" IS NULL) OR ("command_receipts"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "command_receipts"."response_status" BETWEEN 200 AND 299 AND "command_receipts"."resource_id" IS NOT NULL AND "command_receipts"."resource_type" IS NOT NULL)

model_connections_scope_owner_check.name: model_connections_scope_owner_check
model_connections_scope_owner_check.value: ("model_connections"."scope" = 'personal' and "model_connections"."user_id" is not null) or ("model_connections"."scope" = 'workspace' and "model_connections"."user_id" is null)

thread_model_preferences_selection_check.name: thread_model_preferences_selection_check
thread_model_preferences_selection_check.value: ("thread_model_preferences"."mode" = 'auto' and "thread_model_preferences"."selected_connection_id" is null and "thread_model_preferences"."selected_model_id" is null) or ("thread_model_preferences"."mode" = 'manual' and "thread_model_preferences"."selected_connection_id" is not null and "thread_model_preferences"."selected_model_id" is not null)

workspace_currency_change_anchor_check.name: workspace_currency_change_anchor_check
workspace_currency_change_anchor_check.value: ("workspace_currency_change_requests"."original_period_start" IS NULL AND "workspace_currency_change_requests"."billing_anchor_day" IS NULL AND "workspace_currency_change_requests"."next_renewal_at" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_currency_change_requests"."original_period_start" IS NOT NULL AND isfinite("workspace_currency_change_requests"."original_period_start") AND "workspace_currency_change_requests"."original_period_start" < "workspace_currency_change_requests"."effective_at" AND "workspace_currency_change_requests"."billing_anchor_day" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_currency_change_requests"."billing_anchor_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND "workspace_currency_change_requests"."next_renewal_at" IS NOT NULL AND isfinite("workspace_currency_change_requests"."next_renewal_at") AND "workspace_currency_change_requests"."next_renewal_at" > "workspace_currency_change_requests"."effective_at")

workspace_entitlements_provider_identity.name: workspace_entitlements_provider_identity_check
workspace_entitlements_provider_identity.value: "workspace_entitlements"."source" <> 'polar' OR ("workspace_entitlements"."provider_environment" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_entitlements"."provider_environment" IN ('sandbox','production') AND "workspace_entitlements"."source_reference" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_entitlements"."provider_updated_at" IS NOT NULL AND isfinite("workspace_entitlements"."provider_updated_at") AND "workspace_entitlements"."provider_state_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_entitlements"."provider_state_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

workspace_entitlements_period_check.name: workspace_entitlements_period_check
workspace_entitlements_period_check.value: ("workspace_entitlements"."current_period_start" IS NULL AND "workspace_entitlements"."current_period_end" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_entitlements"."current_period_start" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_entitlements"."current_period_end" IS NOT NULL AND isfinite("workspace_entitlements"."current_period_start") AND isfinite("workspace_entitlements"."current_period_end") AND "workspace_entitlements"."current_period_start" < "workspace_entitlements"."current_period_end")

workspace_entitlements_grace_check.name: workspace_entitlements_grace_check
workspace_entitlements_grace_check.value: ("workspace_entitlements"."payment_failed_at" IS NULL AND "workspace_entitlements"."grace_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_entitlements"."source" = 'polar' AND "workspace_entitlements"."status" = 'past_due' AND "workspace_entitlements"."payment_failed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_entitlements"."grace_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_entitlements"."paid_activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND isfinite("workspace_entitlements"."paid_activated_at") AND isfinite("workspace_entitlements"."payment_failed_at") AND "workspace_entitlements"."paid_activated_at" < "workspace_entitlements"."payment_failed_at" AND "workspace_entitlements"."grace_expires_at" = "workspace_entitlements"."payment_failed_at" + interval '168 hours')

workspace_entitlements_cancellation_chec.name: workspace_entitlements_cancellation_check
workspace_entitlements_cancellation_chec.value: (NOT "workspace_entitlements"."cancel_at_period_end" AND "workspace_entitlements"."cancellation_period_end" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_entitlements"."source" = 'polar' AND "workspace_entitlements"."cancel_at_period_end" AND "workspace_entitlements"."cancellation_period_end" IS NOT NULL AND isfinite("workspace_entitlements"."cancellation_period_end") AND "workspace_entitlements"."current_period_start" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_entitlements"."current_period_end" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_entitlements"."current_period_start" < "workspace_entitlements"."cancellation_period_end" AND "workspace_entitlements"."cancellation_period_end" <= "workspace_entitlements"."current_period_end")

workspace_usage_reservation_money_check.name: workspace_usage_reservation_money_check
workspace_usage_reservation_money_check.value: "workspace_usage_reservations"."maximum_cost_usd_micros" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND "workspace_usage_reservations"."reserved_usd_micros" BETWEEN 0 AND "workspace_usage_reservations"."maximum_cost_usd_micros" AND "workspace_usage_reservations"."settled_usd_micros" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991

workspace_usage_reservation_state_money_.name: workspace_usage_reservation_state_money_check
workspace_usage_reservation_state_money_.value: ("workspace_usage_reservations"."state" IN ('held','uncertain') AND "workspace_usage_reservations"."reserved_usd_micros"="workspace_usage_reservations"."maximum_cost_usd_micros" AND "workspace_usage_reservations"."settled_usd_micros"=0) OR ("workspace_usage_reservations"."state" IN ('settled','released','reconciliation-required') AND "workspace_usage_reservations"."reserved_usd_micros"=0 AND ("workspace_usage_reservations"."state"<>'released' OR "workspace_usage_reservations"."settled_usd_micros"=0))

product_state_owner_scope.name: product_state_owner_scope
product_state_owner_scope.value: ("product_state"."owner_id"='workspace' AND "product_state"."owner_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("product_state"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "product_state"."owner_id"='user:' || "product_state"."owner_user_id")
